text:
Luke Hughes scored twice on Friday against Calgary, on a night Mike Fink of The Hockey News summed up as "one where the stars took over," and the Devils' younger Hughes is now on pace for the breakout season The Hockey Writers flagged this week. Nine goals in 26 games is already more than a third of his career total before this season.

Be careful with the goals, though. He has nine on 4.8 expected goals, shooting 15.5% after 4% last season. Our numbers think his normal is around 7%, and that finishing rate rarely lasts for a defenseman. Before Friday he had gone nearly a week without a point.

The rest of his game is growing up. He plays 24 and a half minutes a night, hit 30:41 in Columbus, and New Jersey gets 55% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on. NHL EDGE has him 98th percentile for bursts over 20 mph. The question mark is defense: Evolving-Hockey had him bottom 3% of defensemen for chances against last season. Our range has him at 41 to 60 points, which would still be a career year.
